Name: FE_TEXT_EFFECT_PARAM_ST
Description: On-screen text banners: the HUD queue that shows them, how long they stay, and up to three text variants.

Fields.Name: Layout ID
Fields.Description: Menu layout used for the banner: element TextEffect_<value> of the banner screen, which sets its look and animation.

Fields.Name: Display Queue
Fields.Description: Which of the HUD's text-effect queues the text is sent to (0-3). Retail: 3 for day, night and event banners, 2 for status ailment banners, 0 for enemy-felled and result banners, 1 on row 2110.
Appears unused by the game. Retail: 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Text ID
Fields.Description: Text shown in the banner, from the menu text. -1: no text.

Fields.Name: Sound ID
Fields.Description: Sound played with the banner (category m). 0 or less: none.

Fields.Name: Display Simultaneously with Map Name
Fields.Description: When a map name banner is waiting to be shown, it is shown together with this banner (and no longer waits). Off: the banner is shown alone.

Fields.Name: Display Time
Fields.Description: Seconds the text stays on screen before it ends. Negative: stays until the game closes it. Retail: 0 on most rows, -1 on Matchmaking... / Preparing... and the player-name rows, 6 on Matchmaking complete / cancelled, 7 on rows 8001-8006.

Fields.Name: Text ID 2
Fields.Description: Text used when the game shows the second variant of this effect. -1 falls back to Text ID. Retail: set on the Matchmaking and player-name rows.

Fields.Name: Text ID 3
Fields.Description: Text used when the game shows the third variant of this effect. -1 falls back to the second text. Retail: set only on row 10000.
